ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, non-uniform distribution of dark vertical and diagonal streaks overlaid on a predominantly light background; high-contrast dark patches are concentrated in the central-median region and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a high depth-to-width ratio; calculated internal angle approximately 25 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant jaggedness, particularly on the outer distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory following a non-linear curve from the median notch toward the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel patterns visible along the trailing edges and at the distal tips, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (parallel and crossing rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the majority of the visible ventral surface; irregular, possibly traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical lineation pattern of dark pigmentation across the white base color, creating a high-frequency striped texture on the inner lobe areas.
